description: This file defines a custom Android View called BackgroundView that draws four full-screen RGBY triangles as a background, with configurable colors for each segment. It includes methods for rendering graphics and handling size changes.

classes.name: BackgroundView
classes.description: A custom View that draws four colored triangles covering the background, configurable via style attributes.

methods.name: BackgroundView
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the view and retrieves style-based color attributes.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Handles drawing the triangles onto the Canvas using vertex data and colors.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Calculates vertex points for the triangles based on the view's size.
